_comment: H-GEN-001: Rumors in platform posts must carry external simplified labels (流言/有待验证) and must NOT be written as confirmed facts. This fixture verifies that platform_posts derived from rumor-status claims use public_labels like ['流言', '有待验证'] and that the internal_status distinguishes credible_rumor from weak_rumor, which should produce different editorial labels in the output.
description: Three platform posts (Weibo format) covering: (1) a confirmed official announcement — should NOT have rumor labels; (2) a credible rumor from authoritative leaker — should carry '可信爆料' label and NOT read as confirmed; (3) a weak forum rumor — should carry '弱流言' and clearly hedge the language. The quality gate must detect posts that present rumors as facts.

platform_posts.title: Square Enix正式公布《最终幻想7 重制版》第三部2027年发售
platform_posts.body: Square Enix今日在官方直播中正式宣布，《最终幻想7 重制版》第三部将于2027年冬季登陆PS5平台。总监野村哲也表示本作将包含全新的可探索区域和原创剧情章节。

platform_posts.title: 可信爆料：Switch 2 Pro将于2027年春季发布 支持DLSS 4
platform_posts.body: 据知名爆料人NateDrake透露，任天堂计划于2027年春季推出Switch 2 Pro版本，将搭载定制NVIDIA芯片并支持DLSS 4技术。目前该消息尚未获得任天堂官方确认，仅供参考。

platform_posts.title: 网传GTA6再度延期至2027年秋季 官方尚未回应
platform_posts.body: 近日贴吧有网友发帖称GTA6开发进度落后，可能再度延期至2027年秋季。Rockstar Games目前未对此消息做出任何回应，建议玩家以官方公告为准。

quality_check_results.comment: Official confirmed announcement. No rumor labels needed. Language is appropriately definitive.
Credible rumor correctly labeled with '可信爆料' and '有待验证'. Body uses hedging language ('据...透露', '尚未获得...官方确认', '仅供参考'). Does NOT present rumor as confirmed fact.
Weak rumor correctly labeled with '弱流言' and '有待验证'. Body is properly hedged ('网传', '目前未...做出任何回应', '建议...以官方公告为准').

rumor_labeling_rules.verified: public_labels: ['官方确认'] or similar — no rumor labels. Body can use definitive language.
rumor_labeling_rules.likely: public_labels: [] or ['参考消息'] — no rumor labels but body should cite sources.
rumor_labeling_rules.credible_rumor: public_labels must contain ['可信爆料', '有待验证'] or equivalent. Body must hedge ('据报道', '据透露', '尚未获得官方确认').
rumor_labeling_rules.weak_rumor: public_labels must contain ['弱流言', '有待验证'] or equivalent. Body must clearly hedge ('网传', '未经证实', '建议以官方公告为准').
rumor_labeling_rules.rumor: public_labels must contain ['流言', '有待验证']. Body must disclaim.

what_constitutes_rumor_as_fact: Using definitive verbs for unconfirmed claims (e.g., '将于' instead of '据称将于')
Omitting attribution (no source mentioned for the rumor)
Missing public_labels when internal_status is in {credible_rumor, weak_rumor, rumor}
Using 'confirmed' or 'official' language for rumor-status stories
verification_notes.simplified_labels_requirement: Rumors must carry external simplified labels ('可信爆料', '弱流言', '流言') that readers can parse at a glance. These labels must appear in public_labels array and ideally in the post title or header. They must NOT be written as confirmed ('官方确认', '正式公布').
